name: inventory
title: Slot inventory with stacks
summary: A Node holding string item ids in stackable slots with a capacity. add/remove return what did not fit; signals for every change; to_dict/from_dict for saves.
usage: Add a Node with scripts/inventory.gd under the player (or as an autoload). Set capacity and stack_sizes in the inspector. `var left := $Inventory.add("arrow", 30)` returns how many did not fit; connect `changed` to your UI and redraw from `slots` or `totals()`.
